text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in mild decline over the past day, with Ethereum down more than twice as hard, suggesting reduced appetite for altcoins and a flight toward perceived safety. The Fear & Greed index at 25 signals extreme fear despite a modest 3-point weekly improvement, indicating sentiment remains fragile. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 56.3% with $65B in 24-hour volume shows conviction among sellers rather than panic-driven capitulation.
